ArchitectureNotes.objective: GRACE-aware development protocol on a brownfield codebase. Substrate (in-source contracts + LDD logs + START/END markup) takes priority; classical 2-phase TDD is RETIRED. The PDD remains canonical for product intent.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Do NOT replicate PDD content here — that file is canonical. This XML governs the GRACE substrate only.
Do NOT add any feature without an entry in PDD §3 (domain language) and §6 (state machines if it transitions state).
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: INV-004 atomicity: payment + points + promo MUST be a single transaction. Verify in module contracts and verification.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: INV-013 PII isolation: code reviewers must check no PII leaks into order_items or audit tables.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: INV-016 state transitions: any new state-machine transition must update both PDD §6 and verification-plan markers.

contract.purpose: Domain enums plus GRACE LDD logger; zero runtime dependencies.

export-enums.PURPOSE: OrderStatus, PaymentStatus, DeliveryStatus, OtpStatus, UserStatus, PromoStatus

export-grace.logging.PURPOSE: LDD log helper with [Module][function][BLOCK_NAME] markers and belief-state pairs

contract.purpose: Alembic migrations and seed data. Schema changes go through MIGRATE tasks, including menu media fields and finite menu inventory fields. INV-014 enforces immutable order_items.

export-seeds.PURPOSE: Seed scripts for menu, roles, shop settings

contract.purpose: FastAPI HTTP server — all state mutations, auth, RBAC, business logic. Single source of writes for all backend state. INV-002 enforces server-side auth on every mutation.

export-routers.PURPOSE: auth, menu, orders, payment, delivery, addresses, admin/*

export-services.PURPOSE: order_service, payment_service, delivery_service, notification, admin_users, refund_retry

export-models.PURPOSE: SQLAlchemy ORM (User, Order, OrderItem, Payment, Delivery, MenuItem, Promocode, ShopSettings)

export-schemas.PURPOSE: Pydantic request/response schemas per router, including public menu media fields

notes.note-1: All endpoints enforce INV-002 via FastAPI Depends(require_role(...)).
notes.note-2: Atomic flows (payment + points + promo) wrap in a single SQLAlchemy session per INV-004.
notes.note-3: Public menu media fields are presentational; they do not affect pricing, availability, cart validation, order creation, inventory, or state transitions.
notes.note-4: Finite inventory is PostgreSQL-backed on menu_items.inventory_quantity. Cart checks are UX/server validation; checkout owns atomic row locking and decrement inside orders.create.
notes.note-5: Staff order detail may decrypt user_profiles.phone transiently for ADMIN/BARISTA customer contact. The projection is not stored on orders/order_items and must not be logged.
notes.note-6: Admin refund retry is exposed as a Core API command, but payment-worker owns the REFUND_FAILED -> REFUND_PENDING transition after YuKassa accepts the retry.

contract.purpose: Celery worker for YuKassa payment intent creation, webhook processing, refunds. Honors PDD §6.2 PaymentLifecycle transitions strictly (INV-016).
Celery worker for SMS.ru OTP and order notifications. Honors PDD §6.4 OTP lifecycle.
Customer SPA — media-led menu, cart, checkout, profile. Calls core-api via auto-generated OpenAPI client.

export-features.PURPOSE: Cart, checkout, profile, addresses, orders feature folders

notes.note-1: Drink videos are UX media only. The customer SPA must still use core-api for pricing, availability, checkout validation, and order/payment state.

contract.purpose: Staff SPA — admin/barista/courier surfaces, including admin menu media-path editing, operational finite-inventory updates, staff-only order contact affordances, and admin refund retry. Calls core-api via auto-generated OpenAPI client. INV-002 still applies on the server side; client-side role checks are UX only.

export-features.PURPOSE: Orders feed, kitchen, delivery, users, settings, menu media path editing, order contact detail, refund retry

notes.note-1: Admin menu media controls store public local static asset paths only; binary upload/storage is outside v1.
notes.note-2: Order contact phone is rendered only from staff order detail and only for operational contact; user/order lists remain PII-minimized.

DF-Order-Place.NAME: Order placement
DF-Order-Place.step-2: core-api validates auth (INV-002), validates menu items, checks finite inventory caps, computes total in kopecks
DF-Order-Place.step-3: core-api opens DB transaction (INV-004): lock finite-inventory menu rows, create Order(CREATED) + OrderItems(immutable) + Payment(PENDING), decrement finite inventory
DF-Order-Place.step-4: core-api dispatches Celery task to payment-worker for YuKassa intent
DF-Order-Place.step-5: core-api dispatches Celery task to sms-worker for confirmation SMS

DF-Payment.NAME: Payment confirmation
DF-Payment.step-2: core-api dispatches process_webhook task to payment-worker
DF-Payment.step-3: payment-worker opens DB transaction: Payment SUCCEEDED + Order PAID + points credit (INV-004)

DF-Delivery.NAME: Delivery assignment to courier
DF-Delivery.step-1: Barista marks order READY in admin SPA
DF-Delivery.step-2: core-api transitions order; checks delivery vs pickup
DF-Delivery.step-3: For delivery: creates DeliveryAssignment(AWAITING_COURIER) per PDD §6.3
DF-Delivery.step-4: Courier accepts in admin SPA → COURIER_ASSIGNED → PICKED_UP → DELIVERED

DF-OTP-Login.NAME: SMS OTP authentication
DF-OTP-Login.step-5: core-api verifies code, transitions OTP to VERIFIED, creates/updates User per §6.5, issues JWT

Phase-Migration.name: GRACE migration (complete)
Phase-Migration.goal: Adopt GRACE substrate (in-source contracts + LDD + markup) on the existing codebase; retire dev-workflow-kb process layer.
Phase-Migration.step-CP3: Add module + function contracts on Python public APIs (113 files, 374 contracts)
Phase-Migration.step-CP4: Add JSDoc-style contracts on TS exports (121 files, 291 contracts)
Phase-Migration.step-CP5: Wire LDD logger across 8 boundary functions in 7 files
Phase-Migration.step-CP6: Add LDD test fixtures (GraceLogCapture) and convention header
Phase-Migration.step-CP7: Rewrite AGENTS.md (root + 7 module files), create CLAUDE.md, expand README.md, run grace-refresh

Phase-PostMigration.name: Steady-state GRACE development
Phase-PostMigration.goal: All future features use grace-plan → grace-execute → grace-verification flow; no more OpenSpec proposals or RED/GREEN cycles. Existing pre-GRACE features keep their archived OpenSpec audit trail under openspec/.

ExecutionPolicy.worker-owns: Module source files and module-local tests inside the approved write scope. Workers may add contracts and LDD log markers freely; they may not add new state-machine transitions or INV-rule exceptions.
ExecutionPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, suspected INV-rule violation, or PDD §6 state-machine transition not previously defined.
ExecutionPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every step emits assumptions, commands run, log-marker evidence, and next action.
